errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states a count of 2,335 contracts in 2015, while the reference indicates that this value is not mentioned and only the overall trend is provided.
The figure shows a decrease to 2,170 contracts in 2017, not 1,431.7.
The description inaccurately states that the contract value in 2020 decreases to 1,820.0 million лв., while the reference indicates an increase up to 2,576.2 million лв.
The description does not mention that the y-axis represents the values in millions of лв. alongside the number of contracts.
The description fails to mention that the blue line is labeled as 'Брой', which is critical in understanding the figure.
The description does not clarify that both lines are solid and without markers.
The machine-generated description does not explicitly state the purpose of the chart as representing dynamics in the number and value of contracts.
